shared_spec.rationale: This is provider-specific authentication and setup metadata for existing OpenAI-compatible generation transport. It changes neither normalized requests/results nor shared specification inventories, schemas, frozen fixtures, expectations, or release assets. The Python provider-parity metadata witness is deliberately regenerated from the changed declarations while retaining its historical baseline; it is not a shared specification inventory. No candidate release or qualification is claimed.

implementations.rationale: Updates the Reka and Lemonade preset declarations, their focused controls, and their generated Python witnesses. The declaration records required work only and does not claim a live authentication probe or gate outcome.

The C# workspace has no compatibility-preset registry or Reka/Lemonade provider binding, so this provider-specific preset metadata has no native binding to update. The registered workspace gate remains required for the coordinated change.
